question: Are the 3 existing windows reused per the drawings, or are all 4 windows purchased new per the anchor's allowance?
why_it_matters: This changes the window order quantity and lead-time exposure before permit submittal.
unblocks: Window procurement quantity and order timing

choices: Reuse 3 existing + buy 1 new fixed unit (per drawings)

question: Is the job site address 308 Evergreen St (anchor/job record) or 300 Evergreen St (drawing title block)?
why_it_matters: Permit filing, site logistics, and utility coordination all depend on the correct legal address.
unblocks: Permit application filing and site-work sequencing

question: Has the existing main electrical service capacity been verified to support the new 100A subpanel and mini-split?
why_it_matters: Canon requires this verification before any subpanel or HVAC equipment is ordered.

question: Which foundation spec governs: anchor's 12"x12" footing with no CMU wall, or the drawings' 24"x12" footing with CMU stem wall?
why_it_matters: Foundation type and dimensions drive excavation, concrete, and masonry quantities and sequencing.

choices: Drawing spec (24"x12" with CMU stem wall)

question: Is the covered deck shown on the architectural plans part of this job's contracted scope?
why_it_matters: The anchor proposal has no deck line item or pricing at all, so its inclusion changes the framing and roofing task list.

choices: No, deck is out of scope / future phase

question: Does the interior door package include pocket door systems, or standard hinged doors per the drawing's 7-door schedule?
why_it_matters: Pocket doors require different rough framing and change the procurement list versus the drawing's all-hinged 7-door schedule.
unblocks: Interior door framing and procurement scope

choices: Pocket doors included per anchor (1 hinged + 2 pocket)
Standard hinged doors only per drawings (7 total, no pockets)

question: Which LVL beam size governs: anchor's 3-ply 14" or the drawings' 3-ply 1-3/4"x11-7/8"?
why_it_matters: The beam size sets the procurement order and the temporary-shoring plan for opening the existing load-bearing wall.
unblocks: Structural lumber procurement and shoring sequencing

question: Does this job's septic work involve an actual system modification/new install, or inspection and feasibility only?
why_it_matters: TDEC septic permitting carries a 6-week lead time and blocks groundbreaking only if the system is actually modified.
unblocks: Permit sequencing and earliest groundbreaking date

choices: No modification — inspection/feasibility only, no TDEC trigger
Yes — relocating or installing new septic/leach field
Yes — installing a grinder pump system

question: Is the existing basement half-bath being renovated, or only demolished to clear space for the new laundry/storage build-out?
why_it_matters: Determines whether basement half-bath finish work needs its own task line beyond demo.

question: Does the addition footprint or tie-in wall require relocating any existing utilities (heat pump, disconnect, hose bibs)?
why_it_matters: Determines whether the retrofit utility-relocation work package is needed before addition demo can start.
unblocks: checklist item utility_relocations (Utility & equipment relocations (heat pump, disconnect, lines))

question: Is seed/straw site restoration included in this job's contracted scope?
why_it_matters: Determines whether the landscaping work item is included after excavation and demo disturb the yard.

choices: Restoration limited to disturbed areas only

question: Do any existing appliance vents (flue, exhausts) pass through the new roof area and need extending?
why_it_matters: Determines whether the vent-extension task is added to the roofing block.
unblocks: checklist item appliance_vent_extension (Extend existing appliance vents through new roof)

choices: No existing vents in the new roof footprint

question: Does the primary bedroom/closet get hard flooring, carpet, or both?
why_it_matters: Determines whether carpet_floating and/or hard_flooring work packages and their material orders are included.

choices: Carpet in bedroom, hard flooring in bath/closet

question: Should the drawings' 2x12 rafter roof framing be treated as final, or is truss-vs-rafter still an open design decision?
why_it_matters: Roof framing method affects crew assignment and whether trusses need to be ordered ahead of framing.
unblocks: Roof framing task and truss/rafter procurement

choices: Yes, rafters per drawings are final

question: Is the master shower enclosed with glass, or another enclosure type?
why_it_matters: Determines whether the shower glass procurement/install item is included in the plan.
unblocks: checklist item proc_shower_glass (Shower glass (template after tile))
